A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Mlp2 is a novel SPB component, and that it is required for efficient SPB assembly.
Mlp2 is an SPB-associated protein that links the SPB with the nuclear pore complex.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the peripheral Mlp complex is an integral part of the nuclear pore complex, and that this complex is involved in the assembly of the SPB, a key organelle in cell division.
the Mlp assembly at the nuclear pore is not a static structure.

the Mlps are not simply nuclear pore complex proteins, but rather are involved in a variety of nuclear envelope–associated processes, including SPB assembly, spindle assembly, and nuclear pore complex assembly.
